what: A granular synth: two sources made by a small synth from four knobs each (pluck, drone, bell, breath, chirp, sweep, vowel, metal), up to 16 grains morphing between them, an analog bass, a filter, an ADSR, an LFO, phaser, delay, reverb, drive, an arpeggiator, a step sequencer and presets.
author: Tobe313
